test_runs.selector: Full hook contract, behavior, isolation, lifecycle, copied-install, and relevant MCP bundle
negative_cases: Stop never emits continuation/control fields on first delivery, replay, handler failure, or launcher failure.
Source, package mapping, event isolation, and copied installed fixture agree on one empty-output contract.
Unbound chats remain inert and bound prompt/Stop flows remain secret-redacted.
No prior source assertion still expects an obsolete non-empty Stop response.
No release selector, fallback authority, live installed slot, or activation state changed.
Copied installed fixtures are temporary test artifacts only.

test_runs.selector: Python lint, compile, PowerShell syntax, JSON, and whitespace validation
test_runs.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check hook sources/tests; py_compile; PowerShell AST parse; JSON parse; git diff --check
test_runs.output: All checks passed; Python sources compiled; POWERSHELL_AST_PASS; JSON and diff checks returned zero
negative_cases: No live host hook, install receipt, live hook SQLite, helper, tunnel, HIL, pointer, candidate, Git, or subagent action was invoked.
Only pytest-owned temporary fixture paths were written by tests.

limitations: Row209 unifies source, package declaration, and copied installed fixtures; it does not claim live installation proof.
Codex permits Stop control fields upstream, while Evidence Lane deliberately enforces the stricter exact-empty-object subset.
Row210 retains isolated install receipt creation, all-eight-command execution, kill-switch binding, and restart-recovery proof before any enable action.
